# Move damage multipliers

Look up the 1,389 per-move factors shipped with Eternal Voyage.
A factor of 1.65× adds 65% to the damage entering the normal ability calculation. NPCs get 50% of an increase above 1.00×. Reductions carry over in full.

Use [Combat stats and Doriki scaling](../../characters/combat-stats.md) for the growth curves, worked HP examples and how Haki adds to the hit.
